units: <cite ref="Arakhin 7a">Arakh. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>ט׳ דמ״ה</he> the venomous drop (on the sword) of the angel of death, v. next w.—Pl. <he>טִיפַּיָּיא</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:6">Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ</cite> top [read:] <he>ביני ט׳ הוינא מהלכין</he> we walked between the rain drops (so that we did not get wet).
